parameters.content:
## ORCA request router

**Flow:** chat in -> segregate intent -> fan out -> route to the matching knowledge source -> retrieve -> merge -> risk rules + LLM -> answer out.

The Switch node is the segregation point. Each branch is a different retriever:

| branch | reads |
|---|---|
| ocean | MOSDAC THREDDS OSF_CIRC / OSF_WAVE (ISRO) |
| weather | wind, gust, rain, CAPE, tide |
| geospatial | EEZ, IMBL, protected areas, harbours |
| hazard | GDACS cyclone geometry + IMD warning text |
| advisory | document RAG over IMD / INCOIS bulletins |
| catalog | MOSDAC + INCOIS ERDDAP + NASA CMR catalogues |

**Setup**
1. Set the `ORCA_API_BASE` environment variable in the n8n container. On Docker Desktop use `http://host.docker.internal:8017`. If the API runs in the same compose project use `http://api:8000`.
2. Activate the workflow, then point the backend at it with `ORCA_N8N_BASE=http://localhost:5678`.
3. In the UI, tick "route via n8n".

The backend falls back to its in-process orchestrator if this workflow is not reachable, so the demo never hard-fails.
